description.value: GRNHSE at the Refinery is a second-floor cocktail lounge and private event venue situated in Vancouver's Granville Entertainment District, featuring an 18-foot full-service bar, elegant decor, and both indoor and covered outdoor heated patio spaces for groups of 20 to 75. The bar menu spans hand-crafted cocktails, beer, wine, and a food menu with vegetarian and gluten-free options including nachos and salads. While the space is primarily available for private bookings, it also opens to the general public on weekend evenings.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (4 spaces) at 17m; stands (2 spaces) at 68m; stands (4 spaces) at 77m; stands (4 spaces) at 95m. Total: 14 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the address (1115 Granville Street, Vancouver, BC V6Z 1M1) and provides a phone number (604.687.8001) absent from OSM. There is a name discrepancy: OSM lists 'The Refinery' but the website prominently brands this as 'GRNHSE at the Refinery.' The contact page confirms the venue is open to the public on Friday and Saturday evenings, so it is not exclusively private; washrooms are confirmed (booking page: '3 Gender Neutral Accessible Washrooms'); vegetarian and GF options are confirmed from the food-and-beverage menu.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the business as 'The Refinery' but the website operates under the brand 'GRNHSE at the Refinery'.
OSM has no phone number; phone 604.687.8001 sourced from website contact page only — contact_confirmed.phone set to null.
OSM tag outdoor_seating=no conflicts with website describing a covered outdoor heated patio event space.
Venue is primarily a private-event space; public walk-in access appears limited to weekend evenings per contact page.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating cocktail lounge at a confirmed downtown Vancouver address, publicly accessible on weekend evenings with a full food and beverage menu.
enrichment_extras.notes: The ATM referenced on the contact page ('available on the lower level in The Pawn Shop YVR') suggests a shared building with another business called The Pawn Shop YVR on the ground floor.
